question: [Customer health check #1] For 'starter' tier accounts, evaluate Activated Account status (>=3 users and >=1 query_run within 14 days of creation).
sql: WITH account_user_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS total_users FROM accounts AS a JOIN users AS u ON a.account_id = u.account_id WHERE a.plan_tier = 'starter' AND u.created_at <= a.created_at + INTERVAL '14' DAYS GROUP BY a.account_id), account_query_events AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(e.event_id) AS total_queries FROM accounts AS a JOIN users AS u ON a.account_id = u.account_id JOIN events AS e ON u.user_id = e.user_id WHERE a.plan_tier = 'starter' AND e.event_type = 'query_run' AND e.timestamp <= a.created_at + INTERVAL '14' DAYS GROUP BY a.account_id) SELECT a.account_id, CASE WHEN COALESCE(u.total_users, 0) >= 3 AND COALESCE(q.total_queries, 0) >= 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_activated FROM accounts AS a LEFT JOIN account_user_counts AS u ON a.account_id = u.account_id LEFT JOIN account_query_events AS q ON a.account_id = q.account_id WHERE a.plan_tier = 'starter'

question: [Executive summary request #166] For 'enterprise' tier accounts, evaluate Activated Account status (>=3 users and >=1 query_run within 14 days of creation).
sql: WITH account_user_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS total_users FROM accounts AS a JOIN users AS u ON a.account_id = u.account_id WHERE u.created_at <= a.created_at + INTERVAL '14' DAYS AND a.plan_tier = 'enterprise' GROUP BY a.account_id), account_query_events AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(e.event_id) AS total_queries FROM accounts AS a JOIN users AS u ON a.account_id = u.account_id JOIN events AS e ON u.user_id = e.user_id WHERE e.event_type = 'query_run' AND e.timestamp <= a.created_at + INTERVAL '14' DAYS AND a.plan_tier = 'enterprise' GROUP BY a.account_id) SELECT a.account_id, CASE WHEN COALESCE(u.total_users, 0) >= 3 AND COALESCE(q.total_queries, 0) >= 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_activated FROM accounts AS a LEFT JOIN account_user_counts AS u ON a.account_id = u.account_id LEFT JOIN account_query_events AS q ON a.account_id = q.account_id WHERE a.plan_tier = 'enterprise'

question: [Product telemetry review #2221] For 'enterprise' tier accounts, evaluate Activated Account status (>=3 users and >=1 query_run within 14 days of creation).
sql: WITH account_user_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS total_users FROM accounts AS a JOIN users AS u ON a.account_id = u.account_id WHERE a.plan_tier = 'enterprise' AND u.created_at <= a.created_at + INTERVAL '14' DAYS GROUP BY a.account_id), account_query_events AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(e.event_id) AS total_queries FROM accounts AS a JOIN users AS u ON a.account_id = u.account_id JOIN events AS e ON u.user_id = e.user_id WHERE a.plan_tier = 'enterprise' AND e.event_type = 'query_run' AND e.timestamp <= a.created_at + INTERVAL '14' DAYS GROUP BY a.account_id) SELECT a.account_id, CASE WHEN COALESCE(u.total_users, 0) >= 3 AND COALESCE(q.total_queries, 0) >= 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_activated FROM accounts AS a LEFT JOIN account_user_counts AS u ON a.account_id = u.account_id LEFT JOIN account_query_events AS q ON a.account_id = q.account_id WHERE a.plan_tier = 'enterprise'

question: [Customer health check #2222] Count all 'page_view' telemetry events logged from 'desktop' clients since 2023-03-11.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS page_views FROM events WHERE event_type = 'page_view' AND device = 'desktop' AND timestamp >= '2023-03-11'
